review_funding_statement: This pipeline-readiness rehearsal received no external funding.
review_rationale: This run rehearses the chapter's end-to-end scoping-review automation pipeline on a synthetic corpus with replayed model calls, to demonstrate that every methodological artifact the chapter cites is produced and internally consistent before the audited Track-3 run on real data.
review_title: Pipeline-readiness rehearsal: MBSE and computer-simulation methods for rural healthcare disaster preparedness (scoping review)
synthetic_corpus_caveat: This run used a synthetic corpus and replayed model calls; it demonstrates pipeline readiness, not a scientific finding. The audited run on real data is Track 3.
